fullPassage: When we realize we've said something in error and we pause to go back to correct it, we stop gesturing a couple of hundred milliseconds before we stop speaking. Such sequences suggest the startling notion that our hands "know" what we're going to say before our conscious minds do, and in fact this is often the case. Gesture can mentally prime a word so that the right term comes to our lips. When people are prevented from gesturing, they talk less fluently; their speech becomes halting because their hands are no longer able to supply them with the next word, and the next. Not being able to gesture has other deleterious effects: without gesture to help our mental processes along, we remember less useful information, we solve problems less well, and we are less able to explain our thinking. Far from tagging along as speech's clumsy companion, gesture interrupts the rhythm of our narrative.

의식과 무의식 사이의 인지 처리 속도 차이

det.korean: 언어 처리에서 몸짓의 필수적 역할과 인지적 기능
det.analysis:
① 효과적인 말하기 훈련: 글에서 언급되지 않음
② 언어 처리에서 몸짓의 필수적 역할: 글 전체가 몸짓이 언어 처리에 필수적임을 주장 ← 정답
③ 감정 전달: 글에서 언급되지 않음
④ 의식과 무의식 처리 속도: 글의 일부 내용이나 전체 주제가 아님
det.tip: 주제 파악: 몸짓이 말하기에 필수적이라는 핵심 주장

questions.passage: When we realize we've said something in error and we pause to go back to correct it, we stop gesturing a couple of hundred milliseconds before we stop speaking. Such sequences suggest the startling notion that our hands "know" what we're going to say before our conscious minds do, and in fact this is often the case. Gesture can mentally prime a word so that the right term comes to our lips. When people are prevented from gesturing, they talk less fluently; their speech becomes halting because their hands are no longer able to supply them with the next word, and the next. Not being able to gesture has other deleterious effects: without gesture to help our mental processes along, we remember less useful information, we solve problems less well, and we are less able to explain our thinking. Far from tagging along as speech's clumsy companion, gesture interrupts the rhythm of our narrative.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 몸짓은 말이 멈추기 수백 밀리초 전에 멈춘다.
몸짓 없이도 문제를 잘 해결할 수 있다는 연구 결과가 있다.
말의 오류를 인식한 후에도 몸짓은 계속된다.
손이 의식적 마음보다 늦게 말할 것을 파악한다.

det.korean: 몸짓은 말이 멈추기 수백 밀리초 전에 멈춘다.
det.analysis:
① 몸짓이 말보다 수백 밀리초 전에 멈춤: 본문 직접 언급 → 일치 ← 정답
② 몸짓 없이 문제 잘 해결: 반대(less well) → 불일치
③ 오류 인식 후 몸짓 계속: 반대(먼저 멈춤) → 불일치
④ 손이 의식보다 늦게: 반대(먼저 파악) → 불일치
det.tip: 본문 첫 문장: stop gesturing before stop speaking

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
